Metadata.title: AureonX
Metadata.description: Multi-asset trading on a virtual balance. No real money.

Landing.metaTitle: AureonX | Spot and options on live crypto prices
Landing.metaDescription: Trade BTC, ETH and SOL with a full order book or timed Rise and Fall options. Every account runs on a virtual USD balance.

hero.title: Spot and options on live crypto prices
hero.subtitle: Trade BTC, ETH and SOL with a full order book or timed Rise and Fall options. Every account runs on a virtual USD balance.

spot.title: Spot
spot.body: Buy and sell at the live market price, with depth and recent trades on one screen.

options.title: Options
options.body: Choose Rise or Fall and a period, then see your return before you call.

assets.title: Assets
assets.body: Move funds between your Capital, Spot and Options wallets and see every change in Bills.

how.title: How virtual balances work
how.step1: Your account holds a virtual USD balance.
how.step2: Orders and options use live market prices.
how.step3: Every balance change is recorded in Bills, so your history always adds up.

footer.tagline: Live crypto markets on a virtual balance.
footer.disclosure: AureonX runs on virtual balances. No real money is deposited, traded or withdrawn.
